calls.thesis: Reiterated BUY (Oct 5): still the best deal of the AI-power plays at 0.4x PEG despite 223% run over last year; ~66% expected revenue growth this year; collocated on-demand power is the bottleneck.

0.44x PEG (GAAP basis) despite 66% expected revenue growth (after 90% last year); best at colocating power generation at data centers (as fast as 90 days) — 'definitely be picking up more shares' as AI buildout resumes post-midterms.
